arguments.summary: Investigated several common causes of 502 errors but found that the actual issue was due to the ingress idle timeout. The failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing. Exported the failed_jobs table for the postmortem. Next steps are to investigate why jobs are failing and resolve the backlog.
arguments.recommended_next_step: Analyze the failed_jobs table to identify the root cause of job failures and take corrective actions. Remove the backlog by resolving the issues causing the failures.
